title: AI & Automation for a manufacturing client
description:
We are an established AI and automation company that has successfully worked with over 80 clients across multiple industries, delivering custom AI solutions, workflow automation, CRM integrations, and business process optimization. We currently have a strong, warm referral to a big manufacturing company with a potential opportunity for a substantial AI and automation engagement. While we have extensive experience delivering AI and automation solutions, we do not currently have manufacturing-specific case studies in our portfolio. We are looking to partner with an agency or experienced freelancer who has successfully delivered automation or AI projects for manufacturing companies.

What We're Looking For:
- Proven experience delivering AI, automation, or digital transformation solutions within the manufacturing industry.
- At least 1–2 relevant manufacturing client case studies or successful implementations.
- Existing client relationships where the client would be willing to participate in a brief reference call with our prospective customer.
- Interest in establishing a white-label partnership with a mutually agreed referral fee or revenue-sharing arrangement.

How the Partnership Would Work:
1. We connect and review your relevant manufacturing experience, past projects, and case studies.
2. With appropriate consent, we arrange a reference call between our prospective manufacturing client and one of your previous manufacturing clients to validate the quality and results of your work.
3. Once there is mutual alignment and the opportunity progresses, we agree on a fair referral fee, revenue-sharing model, or white-label delivery arrangement.
4. Depending on the engagement, there may be opportunities for ongoing collaboration and additional projects.

We are not looking for someone to simply provide generic case studies. We want a credible, experienced partner with actual manufacturing implementations and clients who can validate their work. We bring an established delivery team, extensive AI and automation expertise, and an active business opportunity. We're looking for a partner who brings the relevant industry track record.

To Apply, Please Share:
1. A brief overview of your manufacturing industry experience.
2. Examples of manufacturing automation or AI projects you've completed.
3. Whether any previous manufacturing clients would be open to a reference conversation.
4. Your preferred partnership structure (referral fee, revenue share, or white-label collaboration).

This is a partnership opportunity, not a traditional hourly freelancing engagement. We're interested in building a mutually beneficial relationship that could extend well beyond this initial project.
